title: HMT Reuse, Extension, and Promotion Policy
principle: Search before forge. Reuse known-good steel when it satisfies the mission; preserve the reasoning and invariants that made it lawful; engineer only the true unresolved delta; measure and validate that delta; promote repeated success into discoverable organizational capability.
organizational_learning_objective: Prevent repeatedly solved engineering problems from remaining tribal knowledge. Once a solution survives materially distinct problem contexts, treat it as a candidate organizational capability that must be documented, versioned, evidenced, hosted, discoverable, and referenced by default.

governing_relationships.relationship: Reuse or extension does not waive tracer-bullet admission.
This policy operationalizes Reusable Steel into a governed lifecycle.
Reusable capability must be self-explaining and discoverable without original-builder presence.
Extension and promotion require cumulative regression and Reverse RCA closure.

reference_build is a strict enforcement mechanism for reference-bounded transformation; this policy is broader and also permits reasoning inheritance, composition, and alternate compliant implementations.
Reuse tooling does not alter the existing completion transaction or grant task-completion authority.

reuse_dispositions.REUSE_AS_IS: Use the admitted capability without internal modification; bind it to the new mission through declared adapters/configuration only.
reuse_dispositions.ADAPT: Apply bounded interface, configuration, or representation changes while preserving the underlying capability and authority semantics.
reuse_dispositions.EXTEND: Add new behavior around or beneath an admitted capability while preserving inherited contracts and explicitly validating the added delta.
reuse_dispositions.COMPOSE: Combine two or more admitted capabilities through typed seams without silently merging authority or failure semantics.
reuse_dispositions.SUPERSEDE: Replace an older canonical capability only through explicit versioned promotion, migration guidance, and human disposition.
reuse_dispositions.NO_FIT: No admitted capability can satisfy the unresolved requirement without violating mission, invariant, authority, fidelity, or interface constraints.

required_actions: Inventory applicable admitted kernels, tools, plants, field cards, schemas, policies, ontologies, reference implementations, and prior evidence.
Record artifact identity, version, source location, and content hash for each selected candidate.
Record one reuse disposition for each materially applicable candidate.
Record rejection reason for any applicable candidate not selected.
Identify the unresolved mission-specific delta before authorizing new engineering.
Bind the selected steel and unresolved delta to the active mission/assignment.

inheritance_modes.STRUCTURAL_INHERITANCE: Candidate preserves the admitted structure and applies an explicit bounded delta. Use reference_build when exact reference-bounded transformation is appropriate.
inheritance_modes.REASONING_INHERITANCE: Candidate may have a different structure, but must preserve and trace the source requirements, invariants, assumptions, trade decisions, failure semantics, and non-claims that remain applicable.
inheritance_modes.COMPOSITION_INHERITANCE: Candidate composes multiple admitted assets; each source keeps its lineage, authority boundary, qualification status, and failure semantics.

true_delta_rule.statement: New engineering SHALL be limited to the smallest mission-specific delta that cannot be satisfied through REUSE_AS_IS, ADAPT, EXTEND, or COMPOSE.

no_fit_gate.rule: NO_FIT authorizes investigation of new steel, not unrestricted architecture generation.

lineage_contract.rule: Copied code without preserved reasoning and evidence lineage is not compliant reuse. Different implementation shape is permitted when source reasoning and requirements remain traceable.

reasoning_trace_contract.required_question: Which inherited requirements, invariants, assumptions, and prior decisions constrained this candidate, and how are they satisfied now?
reasoning_trace_contract.acceptance_rule: A candidate need not duplicate the source structure when its reasoning lineage is explicit, the resulting shape satisfies the governing requirements and invariants, and verification closes the delta.
reasoning_trace_contract.documentation_expectation: Documentation SHOULD read as build-time reasoning and evidence, not post-hoc inference from finished code.

rules: Reuse SHALL NOT waive mission-specific tracer validation.
Reuse SHALL NOT waive package tests, cumulative gates, Reverse RCA, scaffold verification, or human review where required.
Prior evidence MAY reduce rediscovery effort only after applicability to the new mission is explicitly checked.
Inherited capability failures discovered in a new mission SHALL route upstream through Reverse RCA and may trigger a shared-steel repair or qualification hold.
No reused capability gains operational authority merely because it was previously promoted elsewhere.

promotion_to_organizational_capability.trigger: A local capability becomes a promotion candidate after it has solved at least two materially distinct problem contexts with evidence-backed verification and without unresolved authority or fidelity mismatch.

hosting_and_discoverability.rule: A promoted reusable capability SHALL be hosted in an authoritative versioned location and discoverable through the normal human/agent discovery surface before it is treated as organizational steel.

supersession_policy.rule: Canonical reusable steel SHALL NOT be silently replaced or left ambiguous after a successor is promoted.
required_actions: Assign a new version or new canonical capability ID.
Do not delete historical evidence required for audit or replay.

requirements.rule: Every substantial build SHALL execute the Reuse Discovery Gate before new architecture or implementation is admitted.
Applicable existing steel SHALL receive an explicit reuse disposition and any rejection SHALL cite requirement, invariant, authority, fidelity, or interface evidence.
New engineering SHALL be limited to the identified true mission-specific delta.
Reuse SHALL preserve source reasoning, requirements, invariants, authority boundaries, failure semantics, qualification status, and evidence lineage.
Different implementation shape MAY be admitted when reasoning lineage is preserved and the resulting artifact independently satisfies applicable requirements and invariants.
NO_FIT SHALL be evidence-backed and SHALL only authorize the bounded new-steel scope required to close the unmet requirements.
Reuse SHALL NOT bypass tracer, V&V, RRCA, cumulative gates, package tests, or required human review.
A repeatedly successful local solution SHALL enter promotion review rather than remain undocumented tribal knowledge.
Promoted steel SHALL be versioned, hosted, documented, discoverable, and linked to its evidence and supersession status.
Reuse, adaptation, extension, composition, and supersession SHALL NOT silently widen operational authority.

exclusions: This policy does not require literal template reuse when reasoning inheritance is the better engineering path.
This policy does not treat code copying alone as reuse.
This policy does not auto-promote a capability because it worked twice.
This policy does not grant operational authority, task completion, deployment, or activation.
This policy does not replace mission-specific architecture, physics, safety, cybersecurity, fidelity, or qualification requirements.
This policy does not prohibit novel engineering; it requires the unresolved novelty to be identified and justified.
